exposure: scheduled delivery (labor induction after stopping LMWH)
unscheduled delivery (stopping LMWH at labor onset)
cohort: 129 pregnant women with LMWH treatment, singleton pregnancy, gestational age ≥ 38 weeks, and eligible for vaginal delivery
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of epidural analgesia between scheduled and unscheduled deliveries in women with LMWH treatment.
mod_finding: The study found high rates of epidural analgesia in both scheduled and unscheduled deliveries for women with LMWH prophylaxis, suggesting that scheduled delivery may not be advantageous for this purpose.
